comments.text:
frames 134,135 track the pose incorrectly.
frame 136 tracks the wrong arm (tossing arm)
frame 137,138 also displays wrist at the wrong arm
this problem occurs also on later frames prior to the real contact.
frames 158 to 176 track the correct wrist mostly correct (some inaccuracies when the wrist is hidden behind the body during the follow through of the serve.
tbd: Adapt logic so that a continuous tracking path that also matches the detection criteria is preferred over a sequence of jumping / missing detection frames, that also happen to match detection criteria.
